method: Local tree-sitter parse of every .swift and .m file (<=8 MiB) in each public archive with the pinned grammars (tree-sitter 0.25.2, tree-sitter-swift 0.7.4, tree-sitter-objc 3.0.2). For files with native errors, the APSA 1.2.0 adaptations and the development adaptations were applied separately and a file counts as recovered when its adapted text parses without errors. Measured once; no adaptation was changed in response.
note: Recovery means the file parses; Objective-C functions overlapping normalized preprocessor branches are still skipped as uncertain.
